d.ko: Who's Your Daddy is a casual multiplayer game featuring a clueless father attempting to prevent his infant son from certain death. Play with up to 7 of your friends, and test your parenting skills in a competitive setup with wacky physics and over 67 potentially ominous household items.
d.en: Who's Your Daddy is a casual multiplayer game featuring a clueless father attempting to prevent his infant son from certain death. Play with up to 7 of your friends, and test your parenting skills in a competitive setup with wacky physics and over 67 potentially ominous household items.
d.zh: Who's Your Daddy是一款休闲多人游戏，游戏中一个毫无头绪的父亲试图阻止他的婴儿儿子死亡。与多达7个朋友一起玩，以竞争性设置测试你的育儿技巧，游戏中有疯狂的物理效果和超过69个可能具有不祥预兆的家庭用品。
